mechanism: analyse() runs on a thread created with default attributes and declares a 512 KiB local array (double window[65536]). The default QNX pthread stack is 256 KiB (Linux uses 8 MiB), so the thread overflows its stack and faults (SIGSEGV). Fix: create the thread with a larger stack (pthread_attr_setstacksize) or move the buffer off the stack.
